in_hebrew.name: Fuld
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fuld הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Fulda was a goddess of wisdom, counsel, and protection. In Christian tradition, Fuld is a masculine name derived from the goddess' name, symbolizing strength, guidance, and spiritual enlightenment.

In Christian tradition, Fuld is a masculine name derived from the goddess' name, symbolizing strength, guidance, and spiritual enlightenment.
